entries.title: "Hey, Hey, Goodbye"
lines: Sit around and wait too much
Go around and hate your guts
Can't believe it's true,
that I was in love with you
Hey, hey, goodbye I'll miss you till I die
Hey, hey, goodbye I promise I won't cry
I won't cry Hey, hey, goodbye
Send a packet 'cross the sea
Send a mail delivery
With my thoughts to you
I hope your sun shines too
Hey, hey, goodbye I'll miss you till I die
Hey, hey, goodbye I promise I won't cry
I won't cry Hey, hey, goodbye
Now the time has come to an end
Maybe I'll never see you again
My love to you
And this time I'm sure it's true
Hey, hey, goodbye I'll miss you till I die
Hey, hey, goodbye I promise I won't cry
I won't cry Hey, hey, goodbye

entries.title: "Lonesome Town"
lines: Watching TV, drinking whiskey, drinking beer
on a Saturday night And you're not here
I'd like to see you soon
Full moon, starry night, still I'm home
alone all by myself There is no one
else around I'm kinda lonely in this town
Listening to the radio, drinking rum, crying tears
on a Sunday morning And you're not in sight
Just like last night
Blue sky, clear sky, still I'm inside
with the sun outside

entries.title: "Sailor's Waltz"
lines: I'll tell you a story of a man I know
He has wisdom and courage that few of us show
And he traveled from his home and into the seas
If you listen to the story I'll tell you 'bout this
The mighty Atlantic, yes that was the ship
He sailed 'cross the ocean in wild winds and rips
He never looked back at the shores he once knew
When he looked at the stars he would know what to do
The storm was approaching from the south
And the waves built up high, high as house
The crew on the bridge prepared for the end
And they opened a bottle of finest blend
The captain was drunk, and sent down below
And the young man was fighting alone in the storm
All the waves that hit him He didn't count them all
But he fought like a demon in angels' storm
The ship took in water The radio was broke
But the men in the engine-room stayed at their post
He watched the anchor-hatch for every hit
Had that hatch broken open that would have been it
After seven days at sea they docked Boston's bay
And all of the crew-members stopped to pray
And they all understood if it hadn't been for you,
they all would have rested in the ocean blue

entries.title: "The Sea, You And Me"
lines: The summer, it's on its way
I feel I want it to stay
The sea, you and me,
makes me free
In the ocean, under the sky,
is the place I wish to die
Seagulls' wings can fly
In the heavens, you and I
Here before the storm,
that awaits us all
Royalty of the sea
is what we want to be
The summer, it's on its way
I feel I want it to stay
The sea, you and me,
makes me free
In the ocean, under the sky,
is the place I wish to die
Royalty of the sea
is what we want to be
